title: Your Receipt Was Never Printed With Ink

scenes.narration: A receipt left in a wallet slowly goes blank, because there was never any ink on it.
scenes.note: The blank receipt is the hook. Everyone has been here.

beats.action: Bill pulls a receipt from a wallet; the print is almost gone
the remaining text fades out entirely as he holds it
a NO INK label lands and holds

scenes.narration: Receipt paper is coated with a colorless dye and a chemical developer sitting right next to each other, doing nothing.
scenes.note: Two chemicals, side by side, inert. They must look harmless before they react.

beats.action: the paper sections; a thin surface coating draws on top
colourless dye particles label themselves within the coating
developer particles sit beside them, separate and unreacted
the dye and developer particles drift, still separate
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: The printer has no ink and no ribbon. It has a row of tiny heaters.
scenes.note: The printer reveal: no cartridge, no ribbon, just heat. Show the absence first.

beats.action: a receipt printer opens; an empty cartridge slot is circled and crossed out
a RIBBON label crosses out too
a row of tiny heating elements draws across the print head, glowing
the printer housing opens further, showing the empty carriage
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: Wherever it touches, the coating melts, the two chemicals meet, and that spot turns black.
scenes.note: The reaction, magnified. Melt, meet, blacken.

beats.action: a heating element presses onto the coating
the coating softens under the heat
dye and developer meet and the spot turns black; letters form across the paper
more letters form as the head travels along the paper
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: The catch is the reaction never locks. Heat off a dashboard or friction in a back pocket keeps driving it until the text vanishes.
scenes.note: The flaw: the reaction never locks. Show the same chemistry continuing where it should not.

beats.action: the printed spot holds, but the two chemicals stay live beneath it
a LOCKED? label appears over the print and crosses out
sunlight through a windscreen and friction in a pocket drive the reaction onward
the whole receipt darkens over, then empties to blank; hard cut
the remaining text thins toward nothing
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap
